data_section_full_text:
3.1. Sample Selection


Our primary analysis includes a total of 2,804 firm-year observations from 1993
through 2001. We include observations in our sample if there is sufficient Value Line,
IBES, Compustat and CRSP data to estimate the variables described above. The
number of observations varies year-by-year and increases across time; 1993
contributes the fewest number of observations to the sample (102) and 1997
contributes the most (503).
